ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a bed for {OTHER_nameDef} in {PAWN_possessive} room
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist bonded to a small animal wants it sleeping in their room, not out with the herd.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: An animal bed or sleeping spot in {PAWN_nameDef}'s bedroom.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} curls up outside my door every night anyway. Could we put a bed for {OTHER_objective} on the inside?
Just a corner of my room for {OTHER_nameDef}, with a blanket on the floor. I'll sweep up the hair.
[winter] The animal pen is freezing at night. {OTHER_nameDef} could sleep at the foot of my bed instead.
[night] I woke up and {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't there. I didn't sleep again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} follows me around all day. I'd like {OTHER_objective} close at night too, somewhere soft.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps with me. Build a bed or I'll share mine.

cheerful.li: A little bed for {OTHER_nameDef}, right next to mine! With a blanket, and maybe a tiny pillow.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has never once let me down. I'd sleep better with {OTHER_objective} in the room.

cold.li: Bonded animals settle better when they sleep near their handler. Put a bed for mine in my room.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} turned around three times and lay down like {OTHER_pronoun} owned the place.

warm.li: Listen to {OTHER_nameDef} snore. Best sound in the colony.

cheerful.li: Look at {OTHER_objective} curled up in {OTHER_possessive} own little bed! I could watch {OTHER_objective} all evening.

plain.li: Back out with the herd, then. {OTHER_nameDef} whined at my door half the night.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} patched up
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist's bonded animal is hurt, and they won't rest until it's tended and back on its feet.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still bleeding. Could a doctor look at {OTHER_objective} before the day's out?
I know the doctors have people to see first. But {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't been tended at all.
[afterraid] {OTHER_nameDef} was in that fight with us and came out of it bleeding. Get a doctor to {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: Could a doctor see {OTHER_nameDef}? I'll do anyone's chores for a week.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is being so brave about it! Let's get {OTHER_objective} stitched up and back on {OTHER_possessive} feet.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is lying in the straw, breathing shallow. I don't think {OTHER_pronoun} can wait much longer.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} took months to train. Losing {OTHER_objective} to an untended wound would be a waste.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is up and limping around like nothing happened. Thank you.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} licked my face. That's from both of us.

gloomy.li: I'd already picked out a spot to bury the poor thing. I'm glad I didn't need it.

plain.li: I sat up with {OTHER_nameDef} all night and changed the bandages myself.
